question: Anong mga plano, clearance, at pirma ng inhinyero ang kailangan para makakuha ng Building Permit sa OCBO?
answer:
Ang mga plano, clearance, at pirma ng inhinyero ang kailangan para makakuha ng Building Permit sa Office ng City Building Official (OCBO) ay nababasa sa mga ibaba na mga source blocks:

[S3] - Ang mga plano ay kinakailangan sa chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0002-C001.
[S4] - Ang approved plan of Building Permit ay kinakailangan sa chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0013-C004.
[S4] - Ang structure images with CAAP clearance (kasama ang submitted structural survey para sa actual building height) ay kinakailangan sa chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0013-C004. Ang clearance na ito ay makukuha mula sa CAAP at sa hired geodetic engineer.

ground_truth: To secure a Building Permit under PD 1096, applicants must submit: 1) Notarized Application Letter; 2) Accomplished Unified Building Permit Form (5 copies); 3) Complete sets of Architectural, Civil/Structural, Sanitary/Plumbing, Electrical, and Mechanical Permit forms and plans (5 sets each), all duly signed and sealed by licensed professionals (Architect, Civil Engineer, Sanitary Engineer/Master Plumber, Professional Electrical Engineer, Professional Mechanical Engineer); 4) Certified true copies of Land Title (LRA), Tax Declaration, and Current Real Property Tax Receipt; 5) CPDO Zoning Locational Clearance; and 6) BFP Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC).
